claims.text: Supplied sparse candidate edges are preserved through sample loading, collation, device transfer, training and inference without invoking the quadratic forward fallback.
claims.permitted_inference: audited public training and inference paths only
claims.falsifier: any supplied-edge public path invokes complete candidate discovery, reverses directed edge semantics or changes graph membership
claims.uncertainty: neighbor-list preprocessing complexity is outside the model-forward claim
claims.next_action: retain the preprocessing boundary in every performance claim

claims.text: The frozen edge-conditioned local sum operator is permutation-consistent and O(3)-equivariant for scalar, polar-vector and even rank-2 messages.
claims.permitted_inference: implemented finite tested configurations, not a universal proof of every future feature path
claims.falsifier: any valid relabeling or rigid transform exceeds 1e-6 after aligned comparison
claims.uncertainty: periodic, axial, pseudoscalar and force paths are excluded
claims.next_action: add parity-complete types only in a separately tested packet

claims.text: The registered factorized global kernel avoids materializing an N-by-N pair tensor and can exhibit a large-N memory/runtime crossover against materialized dense evaluation of the same kernel.
claims.permitted_inference: measured hardware, dtype, sizes and exact finite kernel only
claims.falsifier: factorized output disagrees above 1e-10, materializes quadratic pairs, or shows neither a crossover nor a materially lower large-N slope/storage
claims.uncertainty: a crossover size is hardware, dtype, width and implementation dependent
claims.next_action: re-measure crossover on each deployment hardware and shape

claims.text: A bounded-local plus factorized-global EC-LGL has O(E_local + N) content-validated model execution at fixed width and can avoid the dense-edge EGNN regime when E_local is capped.
claims.permitted_inference: trusted model hot path after edge-content validation; neighbor construction and one-time validation are excluded, and the dense-EGNN crossover is descriptive because the computations differ
claims.falsifier: the trusted candidate forward constructs all pairs, invokes sorting/uniqueness validation, or its retained work grows superlinearly under fixed local degree
claims.uncertainty: preprocessing, validation cost and task accuracy after discarding dense domain edges remain outside the claim
claims.next_action: supply a domain-appropriate bounded neighbor builder and report its separate cost

claims.text: The frozen EC-LGL composite improves the matched QM9 validation accuracy enough to justify confirmation and possible promotion.
claims.permitted_inference: QM9 random-row validation under the frozen short-update harness only
claims.falsifier: the screen regresses beyond 0.020 eV or any confirmation promotion threshold fails
claims.uncertainty: short training, CUDA drift and random-row splitting limit generalization and causal attribution
claims.next_action: in a new preregistered packet, test one bounded normalization or staged EC residual against the recorded instability

claims.text: Any measured scaling or QM9 result does not by itself establish protein, chiral molecule or generic point-cloud superiority.
claims.falsifier: the final report promotes the result outside the tested graph, symmetry, preprocessing or split regime
claims.uncertainty: domain-specific adapters and transfer splits are not implemented in this packet
claims.next_action: retain separate domain, chirality, preprocessing and split gates in future reports
